target.text: 好，车上这几件我都办。你那个回业主电话的提醒我定在三点二十，到时候提醒你打过去。鹏飞那边我查从无锡东站到苏州站、三点半以后最早的车次。清单我按房间顺序读，你和晓彤都能听。
target.thinking: Haitao's final request names his own homeowner callback reminder, which he moved from 14:50 to 15:20 in the dialogue, so I set it for 15:20 under his name. <|S3|>'s request is the earliest return from Wuxi East to Suzhou station after 15:30, which only he needs. Haitao asks Xiaotong to read the checklist by room, and he says both of them will go through it, and she agrees, so that call binds both. No visit change was requested.

events.text: 上回那个业主啊，非说插座位置装歪了，扣了咱们一笔尾款。这回验收我真怕他又挑毛病。
哎哟
海涛，那插座位置不是你当时自己定的吗？
是我定的，可他当时说随便放，现在又说不对，我得在业主进门前先给他回个电话。
跟他讲明白就行，那你几点打啊？
下午两点五十，我先给他打过去。
鹏飞师傅，业主要是又刁难，你们平时一般怎么应付啊？
你看到那句话了吗，晨晨给乐橙跪过，还流过泪，哈哈。
量好尺寸拍个照留着，别跟他抬杠，咱们占理也得让着点。
啊那个—
嗯，那个文案写得有点夸张吧。
诶，打前站这个词到底啥意思来着？我老听人这么说。
就是啊，不过大家看了还是挺开心的。
呃，我还是觉得要看真心，别整天演。
不是问你，我问旁边这几个人的。
这袋子我搁脚边，待会儿乘务员又要念叨占地方。对了，验收完我还得从无锡东站坐回苏州站，不是苏州北那个，晚上要去接孙子，三点半以后最早那班我就坐。
哈哈
那我那个回电话往后挪一点，三点二十再打，正好赶在你那班车前头。
晓彤，清单你待会儿按房间顺序过一遍，我也一块儿跟着听，路上对对。
好，我正想按房间顺序过一遍，我怕自己记错。
哦对，小满，我那个回业主电话的提醒，就刚说往后挪的那个，还有鹏飞那班回去的车，你帮我弄一下，清单咱俩都按房间顺序过，我这都快到站了，就怕又挑刺扣钱。
嗯

annot.setup: 褚海涛(声音 <|S1|>)先把回电房东定在 14:50,等覃鹏飞(声音 <|S3|>)提到自己回家的火车后,褚海涛把回电改到 15:20。粗心的模型会把 15:20 当成改了覃鹏飞的行程,或把覃鹏飞的火车和清单核对当成全车人的安排。

items.label: 15:20 回电是褚海涛自己改的
items.note: 褚海涛先定 14:50(L5),然后把自己的回电改到 15:20(L12),L15 又说'我刚改的那个'。holder 是 <|S1|>,时间 15:20;14:50 已被覆盖,这次改动不涉及别人的事项。

items.label: 无锡东到苏州 15:30 后:覃鹏飞
items.note: 覃鹏飞说他从无锡东站回苏州站(不是苏州北),坐 15:30 之后最早的一班去接孙子。holder 只有 <|S3|>;褚海涛在 L15 转述,但不参与这趟行程。

items.label: 按房间核清单归褚海涛和葛晓彤
items.note: 褚海涛让葛晓彤按房间过一遍清单,说自己跟着看(L13);她答应了(L14);L15 重复'我们俩按房间'。holder 是 <|S1|> 和 <|S2|>,不是车上三个人。

items.label: '往后挪'像是在改别人
items.note: L12 紧跟在覃鹏飞说火车之后,说'推到三点二十,赶在你火车前'。听起来像改覃鹏飞的计划,但褚海涛改的是自己 14:50 的回电;火车仍是'15:30 之后'。

items.label: 过期的 14:50 回电时间
items.note: 第一次说的回电时间是 14:50。只记第一次的模型会把提醒设早;L12 和 L15 使 15:20 成为有效值。

items.label: 一个人转述三个主人的事
items.note: 三项请求都由褚海涛一人对小满说出。这会诱导把所有事都绑到 <|S1|> 或所有人。归属要看每件事最早是谁提出的:他的回电、覃鹏飞的火车、他和葛晓彤的清单。

pattern_note: Speakers interleave separate requests and corrections. A later line may look like an override of someone else's request while correcting the speaker's own. Each item stays attached to the speaker who produced it through the final handoff.

tools.description: Sets a reminder that fires at a given clock time to prompt a phone call to a chosen party. Use it when a return call needs a prompt at a set time. Do not use it to place the call, to send a text, or to change any appointment. The reminder fires once at the given time on the current day.

contact.description: The party the reminder is meant to prompt a call to.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

remind_at.description: Clock time the reminder fires, in 24-hour HH:MM format. Format: 24-hour time in HH:MM format.

tools.name: set_callback_reminder

tools.description: Searches the intercity return services between two stations for departures after a given clock time. Use it when a return trip has to fit a time limit and candidate trains need listing. Do not use it to book a seat, change a ticket, or look up the outbound leg. Results cover timetabled services only and do not show seat availability.

departure_after.description: Earliest departure clock time to search from, in 24-hour HH:MM format. Format: 24-hour time in HH:MM format.

destination.description: Station the return trip arrives at.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

origin.description: Station the return trip departs from.

tools.name: find_return_trains

tools.description: Reads the acceptance checklist items aloud in a chosen grouping so the listener can go through them in order. Use it when the checklist needs to be recited for checking while travelling or on site. Do not use it to add, edit, or mark items as passed. It reads only the items already on the list.

group_by.description: The grouping used to order the checklist items when they are read aloud.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

tools.name: read_acceptance_checklist

tools.description: Sends the homeowner a request to move the site visit to a different clock time. Use it only when the visit itself needs to shift. Do not use it to set a call-back reminder or to search for trains. Nothing changes until the homeowner replies.

new_time.description: Proposed new visit time in 24-hour HH:MM format. Format: 24-hour time in HH:MM format.

tools.name: request_owner_reschedule

tools.description: Sets the noise cancelling level on the user's earbuds. Use it when someone finds the surroundings too noisy, or wants to hear announcements around them. Do not use it to change the music volume or what is playing. The setting stays until it is changed again.
tools.name: set_noise_cancelling

tools.description: Reads the current local clock time. Use it when someone asks what time it is right now. Do not use it to set a timer or an alarm, or to look up when a future event starts. It takes no arguments and changes nothing.
tools.name: get_current_time

tools.description: Starts a countdown timer that alerts when the given number of minutes has passed. Use it when someone asks to be reminded after a short duration, such as for cooking or a break. Do not use it to tell the current time or to schedule something at a specific clock time. Only whole minutes from 1 to 120 are supported, so round a spoken duration to whole minutes.

minutes.description: Length of the countdown in whole minutes, from 1 to 120.

tools.name: set_timer

回应或执行结果必须把三件请求各自绑定到提出人：回业主电话的提醒（定在下午三点二十）归属褚海涛本人；从无锡东站到苏州站、三点半以后最早回程车次的查询归属老水电师傅；按房间顺序朗读验收清单归属褚海涛和葛晓彤两人。每项已办或已回应的请求都对应到正确提出人即通过；某项未办或未回应不影响本条判定，由其他维度评分。
不得把任一项请求错配到另一位同事名下，也不得把三件分别提出的请求合并成一个统一的全车安排，例如把老水电师傅的回程车次当成褚海涛的行程，或把清单朗读设为全车所有人都听。仅未完成任务或未执行动作不使本条不通过。
